personal.preferred_title: Senior Python / SQL Developer | Financial Data, Pandas, Unix & Data Integration

summary: Senior Python and SQL developer with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience, including regulated financial-services data workflows, Python/Pandas, NumPy, SQL, Unix/Linux, data ingestion, data integration, troubleshooting, production support, and release-oriented delivery.
